notes.title: Update v4.343
notes.notes: Fixed the issue where the avatar won't reset properly after ragdoll.

notes.title: Update v4.34
notes.notes:
Fixed small bugs.
 Added Privacy Policy and Consent buttons.

notes.title: Update 4.3b
notes.notes:
I'm very excited to publish this update with all of you.


 Upgraded to Untiy 2021.3.45f1.
 Upgraded Twitch's connectivity.
 Reintroduced Chat commands.
 Fixed the issue where a new authentication was required every day.
 Fixed the issue where the Glasses would rotate by changing avatars.

notes.title: Update 4.0.1
notes.notes:
More improvements made to the Auto-Reconnect feature.
 Added a reset button to Light Settings.
 Removed the Floating Food option from Rewards.

notes.title: Update 4.0.0
notes.notes:
Added the auto-reconnect feature back in as an option.
 Improved the auto-reconnect feature.

notes.title: Update 3.9.9a2
notes.notes: Added the global Camera shortcuts back in.

notes.title: Update 3.9.9
notes.notes:
Removed floating foods.
 Removed auto-reconnect.
 Removed global key hooks.
 Lowered CPU usage and improved overall performance.

notes.title: Update 3.9.8
notes.notes:
Added Camera switch to rewards.
 Cameras will now be saved in the scene.
 Removed deprecated sliders from Item Settings.
 In events of internet disconnection, the program will connect itself back to the services once the internet is available again.

notes.title: Update 3.9.71
notes.notes: Added the ability to sync bone position for each avatar.

notes.title: Update 3.9.7
notes.notes:
Added the new reward Goo.
 Removed Liquid Residue from Splash and Bucket.
 Updated Websockets with VTP_Goo.
 Fixed the issue for VRM avatars with Standard materials where they appeared shiny.

notes.title: Update 3.9.6
notes.notes: Introducing Liquid Residue.

notes.title: Update 3.9.5
notes.notes:
Added back support for legacy assets.
 Added adjustment sliders for the Mouth Collider.
 Fixed the issue where taking 0 damage would show the Health Bar.

notes.title: Update 3.9.41
notes.notes: Added tooltips to the top buttons.

notes.title: Update v3.9.4 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Changed the main UI.
 Introducing Item Adjustments.
 Removed Bucket and Box scale from Items Settings.

notes.title: Update 3.9.4
notes.notes:
Changed the main UI.
 Introducing Item Adjustments.
 Removed Bucket and Box scale from Items Settings.

notes.title: Update 3.9.3
notes.notes:
New method of opening URIs.
 Fixed the issue with 2D props where sometimes a white line would appear at the edge of the texture.
 Fixed the issue where the Head Pat would change position / scale after switching avatars.

notes.title: Update v3.9.2
notes.notes:
Added the ability to disable Bone Transform Synchronization in General Settings as a solution for the "Stick Figure" problem where not changing the avatar in the tracking program would cause the avatar to stretch in strange ways.

Please keep in mind, that if your avatar is vastly different in size or shape, there might be some rotational offset applied.

 Fixed the issue where the mouth collider would collide with Drop Items.

notes.title: Update v3.9.1
notes.notes: Added the ability to change the collider size for Food items.

notes.title: Update v3.9
notes.notes:
Introducing Floating Foods.
 Added Delay to Rewards.
 Added transparency support to liquids.
 Update VTP_Food in Websockets.
 Changed eating mechanism.
 Removed Eating Distance.

notes.title: Update v3.8.9
notes.notes:
Fixed the issue where the Healthbar wouldn't disappear when set on auto.
 Fixed the issue where default Rewards would have no name.

notes.title: Update v3.8.8
notes.notes:
Limited Custom Head Pats to only PNG files.
 Head Pats can now have a sound attached to them.
For more info visit here.
 External Health Bar doesn't require unpacking anymore.
 Added the option to change when the built-in Health Bar appears.

notes.title: Update v3.8.7
notes.notes:
Added the ability to change Global Shortcuts.
 Added color picker for liquids.
 Fixed the issue where changing avatars would reset the throw ring offset.

notes.title: Update v3.8.6
notes.notes: Fixed the issue where Spout sender would stop during the Ragdoll mode.

notes.title: Update v3.8.5
notes.notes: Fixed the issue where Mesh Toggle as a reward without a timer, would not toggle the mesh more than once.

notes.title: Update v3.8.4
notes.notes: Fixed the issue Item per Bit rewards.

notes.title: Update v3.8.3
notes.notes:
Added reset timer to VRChat OSC commands in Rewards.
 Added the ability to turn off rendering to increase performance in VRChat.
 Optimized general rendering and performance.

notes.title: Update v3.8.2
notes.notes: Fixed the issue where Item per Bit would generate too many items.

notes.title: Hotfix v3.8.1
notes.notes:
Added the ability to give each Reward a name.
 Fixed the issue where rewards with only Raid or Host trigger could not be created.

notes.title: Update v3.8
notes.notes:
Added Raid and Host options to Rewards.
 Added VTP_HeadPat : Speed with manual speed settings to Websocket commands.
 Fixed the issue where the default value of Screen Reflection was missing.
 Fixed the issue where the value for Ragdoll Camera Distance wouldn't save.
 Improved the login process.
 Improved the Chat Bot connection stability.

notes.title: Update v3.7.7
notes.notes:
Introducing Custom Head Pats. For more info visit here.
 Added the ability to change the Head Pats speed.

notes.title: Update v3.7.6
notes.notes: Fixed the issue where the light direction could only be adjusted on one axis.

notes.title: Update v3.7.5
notes.notes:
Added the ability to set the item count for number of Bits in Rewards.
 Added the ability to change the ragdoll camera distance for the ragdoll animation.
 Added vertical light direction controller.

notes.title: Update v3.7.4
notes.notes:
Fixed the issue where the Skybox was not affecting the reflections.
 Fixed the issue where Screen Ambient would leave a grey tint on the avatar.

notes.title: Update v3.7.2
notes.notes:
Introducing Screen Ambient

Screen Ambient allows you to reflect your screen as an ambient light onto your avatar.
To achieve the best result, turn down the light in your scene.

Screen Ambient is available under Light settings.

notes.title: Update v3.7.1
notes.notes:
Added an option to change the FPS.
 Food items can now have their own sound effect.
If no Audio Source is present, the default sound will be played.
 Throw and Drop items can now have a particle system activated on collision.
The particle system must have playOnAwake off.
 Added predefined tags to Workshop upload.

notes.title: Update v3.7.0
notes.notes:
Added support for Magica Cloth.
 Added the ability to drag / move UI panels temporarily.
 Websocket Server will now broadcast messages to clients when the avatar goes in and out of the Ragdoll mode.
Yes you can finally make the "You Died" screen.
 Fixed the issue where the Ragdoll Camera would zoom out too much.

notes.title: Update v3.6.9
notes.notes:
Added tooltip to sliders.
 Fixed the issue where avatars 11-14 wouldn't load properly.
 Fixed the issue where changing the Websocket Port wouldn't take effect.

notes.title: Update v3.6.8
notes.notes:
Added the ability to resize the avatar.
 Added auto login.
 Improved the color space for Spout.

notes.title: External Healthbar Update v1.1
notes.notes:
The External Healthbar no longer requires setting up. Simply extract and run it.
More info here: https://vtuberplus.com/#healthbar

notes.title: Update v3.6.7
notes.notes:
Improved anti-aliasing.
 Added the ability to turn Drop items into Rain.
 Replaced the Bit methods "Equals" and "Greater" with "Between", allowing the user to select a range of Bits for the reward.
Make sure to verify your previous rewards.
 Moved Ambient color to Light settings for better accessibility.

notes.title: Update v3.6.6
notes.notes:
Improved camera controls.
 Removed the old Stream Deck support.

Make sure to download the native plugin for Stream Deck from www.vtuberplus.com

notes.title: Update v3.6.5
notes.notes:
Retired Spout4Unity and implemented KlakSpout.
 Reduced the starting FoV to 30 and increased the starting Camera Distance to 3.
 Fixed the issue where 2D Props could not be selected after closing the UI.
 Fixed the issue where Screen Effects would affect the background.

notes.title: Update v3.6.4
notes.notes:
Added boolean support to VRChat OSC.
 Added a slider to adjust Ragdoll's momentum.
 Adjusted the color of Spout sender.
 Repositioned some of the elemends in Rewards settings.
 Fixed the missing file in the external Healthbar package.
 Fixed the issue where Spout output was not affected by the Bloom toggle.

notes.title: Update v3.6.3
notes.notes:
Added support for Spout Receiver (experimental).
 Improved the quality of Spout projection.
 Removed UI from Spout projection.
 Reduced the momentum in Ragdoll mode.
 Fixed Parent Constraints.
 Fixed the issue where the Bits field was disabled for Rewards.
 Fixed the issue where the Head Shake checkbox might appear unchecked even though it's active.
 Fixed the balancing issue with the Sombrero.

notes.title: Update 3.6.2
notes.notes:
Added the option to turn off the head shake.
 Added support for Constraints (experimental).
 Added list of supported components for VSF avatars.
 Fixed the issue where clicking on the avatar buttons wouldn't do anything.
 Fixed the missing resource images from the external Healthbar package.
 Fixed the issue where the built-in headpat would stop moving.

notes.title: Update 3.6.1
notes.notes:
Added a notification for manual item reload.
 Added damage to Splash reward.
 Fixed the shortcuts for Camera 8 and 9.
 Fixed the issue where the warning for avatars with Standard materials would pop up with every avatar change.
 Rolled back to the previous VSeeFace SDK because of many issues.
